info.title: Offers AWS API
info.description:
Customer-facing API for managing AWS Marketplace private offers on
`aws.offers.tackle.io`. The API supports the full private-offer lifecycle
(create, read, update, cancel, push to marketplace) plus the AWS Marketplace
context endpoints needed to assemble an offer (agreements, products,
pricing, allowed currencies, partners).

## Authentication

Every endpoint is authenticated with a **Tackle JWT** bearer token passed
in the `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` request header. The token must include
a vendor ID claim and the principal must hold the per-endpoint RBAC
permission listed in each operation's description. A request that lacks
a valid token returns `401`; a request with a valid token but missing
the required permission returns `403` with the missing permission name in
the response body.

## Conventions

- Request and response payloads use `snake_case` field names, matching the
  Tackle developer documentation and AWS Marketplace data model.
- All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings unless noted otherwise.
- Date-only fields are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- Currency codes are 3-letter ISO 4217.
- Monetary amounts are returned as strings to preserve precision.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of private offers visible to the authenticated
principal. Results may be filtered by status, marketplace, offer type,
product reference, salesforce opportunity ID, and creation date.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:ListOffers`

parameters.name: offer_ref
parameters.description: Filter by marketplace offer reference (e.g. AWS `offer-*` ID).

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: Filter to offers created on the given `YYYY-MM-DD` date.

parameters.name: created_at_gt
parameters.description: Filter to offers created strictly after the given date.

parameters.name: created_at_lt
parameters.description: Filter to offers created strictly before the given date.

parameters.name: salesforce_opportunity_id
parameters.description: Filter by associated Salesforce Opportunity ID.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort expression. Prefix a field name with `-` for descending order
(e.g. `-created_at`).

post.description:
Creates a draft private offer. Set `create_in_marketplace: true` in the
request body to also push the offer to AWS Marketplace in the same
call; otherwise the offer is saved as a Tackle draft that can be
pushed later via `POST /private-offers/{id}/marketplace-create`.

Set `dry_run: true` to validate the payload without persisting the
offer; a successful dry run returns `200 OK` instead of `201 Created`.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateDraftOffer`

get.description:
Returns a single private offer by its Tackle ID.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:GetOffer`

put.description:
Updates an existing draft private offer. The body has the same shape as
`POST /private-offers` (`CreatePrivateOfferRequest`).

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateDraftOffer` (the create
permission also gates updates -- updating a draft is treated as the
same authorization concept as creating one).

delete.description:
Deletes a draft private offer.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:UpdateOffer` (the update
permission also gates deletes -- "removing a draft" is treated as a
kind of update).

post.description:
Cancels a private offer that has been pushed to AWS Marketplace but
not yet accepted by the buyer. The cancellation is performed
asynchronously; the response indicates that the request has been
accepted, not that the cancellation is complete. Track completion via
the offer's `status` and `activities` fields, or via webhooks.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CancelOffer`

409.description: Offer is not in a state that can be cancelled.

post.summary: Push Private Offer to AWS Marketplace
post.description:
Promotes a Tackle draft private offer (one created with
`create_in_marketplace: false`) into AWS Marketplace. The push is
asynchronous; this endpoint returns immediately once the request has
been queued.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateOfferOnMarketplace`

409.description: Offer is not eligible for marketplace creation.

get.description:
Returns the seller's AWS Marketplace agreements (entitlements). Used
when assembling an amendment offer to discover an existing
buyer-seller agreement to amend.

Each agreement carries a `public_productid` field which is the AWS
encrypted product ID and can be passed as the `productId` path
parameter to `GET /products/{productId}/pricing`.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateDraftOffer` (agreement
listing is gated on the create permission because it is part of the
offer-creation flow).

parameters.name: buyer_billing_account_ref
parameters.description: Filter to agreements for the given 12-digit AWS buyer account.

parameters.name: offerid
parameters.description: Filter to the agreement produced by the given marketplace offer ID.

parameters.name: next_token
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous response.

get.description:
Returns the AWS Marketplace product listings owned by the authenticated
seller. Use this to populate a product picker before creating a private
offer.

Each product object includes two distinct identifiers:

- `productid` -- the **Tackle** product identifier.
- `encrypted_productid` -- the **AWS Marketplace Catalog API** product
  identifier. This is the value to pass as the `productId` path
  parameter on `GET /products/{productId}/pricing`. Passing
  `productid` instead will result in a `404` because the pricing
  endpoint is sourced from the AWS Catalog API and only understands
  the encrypted form.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:ListProducts`

200.description: List of products owned by the seller.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description:
The **AWS Marketplace Catalog API encrypted product identifier**.

This is **not** the Tackle product ID. Pass the
`encrypted_productid` field from a product object returned by
`GET /products`, or the `public_productid` field from an agreement
returned by `GET /agreements`. Passing the Tackle `productid` (or
`id`) will return `404`.

get.description:
Returns the pricing dimensions, billing terms, and payment-model
defaults for an AWS Marketplace product. Use the response to
pre-populate a private-offer creation form with values that match the
product's public listing.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateDraftOffer` (gated on the
create permission because pricing is fetched as part of the
offer-creation flow).

Returns the 3-letter ISO 4217 currency codes the calling seller may
quote in a private offer. The seller is identified by the vendor ID
in the bearer token; no path parameter is required.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateDraftOffer` (currency
selection is part of the offer-creation flow).

Returns a curated list of AWS Marketplace resale partners with their
company names and AWS account IDs. Use this list to populate a
partner picker when creating a partner (resale) private offer.

**Required RBAC permission:** `offers:CreateDraftOffer`

PrivateOffer.description:
Represents a private offer for any cloud marketplace and product type.
Field shapes are backward-compatible with the `private_offer_metadata`
object documented in the
[Tackle webhook reference](https://developers.tackle.io/reference/sample-private-offer-payloads).

offerid.description:
Marketplace-issued unique offer ID. For AWS partner offers this is
initially the Resale Authorization ID (`resaleauthz-*`); once the
CPPO is extended it is replaced with the CPPO offer ID
(`offer-*`).

vendorid.description: Tackle-issued vendor (ISV) ID that owns the offer.

offer_name.description: The name of the offer as it will appear in the marketplace.

offer_description.description: A human-friendly description of the offer.

offer_type.description:
`direct` is an ISV-to-buyer offer. `partner_resale` is a Resale
Authorization + CPPO offer.

marketplace.description: Always `aws` for offers returned by this API.

productid.description: The marketplace product code (AWS Product Code).

offer_product_type.description: Determines pricing and contract terms for the offer.

positive_targeting.description: Positive targeting (e.g. country allow-list). May be null.

source_offer_id.description: For amendment offers, the marketplace ID of the offer in the existing agreement.

salesforce_id.description: ID of the corresponding Salesforce Opportunity.

offer_expiration_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD date until which the offer is purchasable in the marketplace.

renewal.description:
Indicates that this offer is a renewal of an existing agreement
with the same buyer for the same product.

aws_renewal_moving_to_marketplace.description:
For renewal offers where the existing agreement was originally
outside AWS Marketplace, indicates that the renewal is moving the
agreement into AWS Marketplace.

buyers.description: Recipients of purchase-instructions notifications and activity logs.

offer_metadata.description: Custom internal metadata associated with the offer.

pre_registration_details.description:
Custom public metadata pre-filled for the buyer when registering
their order after offer acceptance.

enable_zero_dollar_prices.description: Whether the offer allows zero-dollar prices on its dimensions.

status.description: Most recent activity status of the offer.

activities.description: History of lifecycle events for the offer.

partner_offer.description: Only set when `offer_type` is `partner_resale`. May be null otherwise.

salesforce.description: Salesforce association for the offer. May be null.

cloud_contract_id.description: The marketplace ID of the cloud contract associated with the offer.

principal_type.description: The type of principal (user, M2M token, etc.) that created the offer.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the first item in this page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page.

total.description: Total number of offers matching the query.

Pricing.description:
Pricing configuration for an offer. Used for all cloud marketplaces,
offer types, and product types. Many fields are conditional on
`payment_model` and `billing_term`; consult the field descriptions
for applicability.

show_on_email.description: Whether to show pricing on the buyer's order-notification email.

marketplace_fee.description: The marketplace's fee for the offer as a percentage. Used to compute contract values.

net_contract_value.description: Expected contract value after the marketplace fee is deducted.

dimensions.description: Base pricing categories with custom pricing.

schedule.description: Schedule of payments. Only applicable when `payment_model` is `payment_schedule`.

payment_model.description:
`per_product` -- one-time fee up front when the offer is accepted.
`payment_schedule` -- flexible payment schedule across the contract.
`saas_subscription` -- pay-as-you-go usage-based pricing.

billing_term.description:
Length of the contract. `custom` requires `duration_value`;
`future_dated` requires `service_start_at` and `service_end_at`.

duration.description: Human-friendly representation of duration value and type.

name.description: User-friendly name of the dimension. Defaults to `api_name` if omitted.

quantity.description:
Quantity of the dimension the buyer is purchasing. Only applicable
when `payment_model` is `payment_schedule`.

price.description:
Price per unit of the dimension. Only applicable when
`payment_model` is `per_product`.

api_name.description:
API identifier of the dimension in AWS Marketplace. If `name`
does not match an existing dimension, a new custom dimension is
added to the product listing (limit 100).

description.description: Human-friendly name of the usage dimension.

sku.description: API identifier of the usage dimension in AWS Marketplace.

invoice_date.description: Date the buyer should be invoiced for this scheduled payment.

invoice_amount.description: Amount the buyer should be invoiced.

email_address.description: The buyer's email used to send purchase instructions.

title.description: Shown in Tackle notifications sent to the seller's team.

type.description:
`public` uses the EULA from the product's public offer.
`aws-standard` defaults to the Standard Contract for AWS
Marketplace (SCMP). `custom` requires `document_urns` to point
at uploaded documents. `use-existing` reuses the EULA from an
existing agreement (replacement offers only).

document_urns.description:
IDs supplied by the Tackle Documents Service after EULA documents
are uploaded.

files.description:
Deprecated: use `document_urns` instead. Retained for backward
compatibility until data migration is complete.

PartnerOffer.description: Details about a partner (resale) offer. Only set when `offer_type` is `partner_resale`.

partner_offer_ref.description: Marketplace identifier for the partner offer (e.g. AWS Resale Authorization ID).

partner_ref.description: Marketplace identifier of the partner (e.g. AWS Account Number).

reseller_agreement.description: Reseller-agreement configuration for the partner offer. May be null.

type.description:
`none-selected` omits a Reseller Agreement. `custom` requires
uploaded documents in `document_urns`. `rcmp-2021-12-01` uses the
Reseller Contract for AWS Marketplace (RCMP).

users.description: Users to notify of lifecycle events of the offer.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes the offer is restricted to.

Agreement.description:
A marketplace agreement (entitlement) between a seller and a buyer for
a product. For AWS this maps to an AWS Marketplace Agreement.

status.description: For AWS, active agreements have status `ACTIVE`.

public_productid.description:
Public marketplace product ID (AWS encrypted product ID). Use this
value as the `productId` path parameter for
`GET /products/{productId}/pricing`.

offerid.description: Marketplace ID of the offer that produced this agreement.

buyer_billing_account_ref.description: Marketplace ID of the buyer's billing account (12-digit AWS account number).

end_date.description: AWS pay-as-you-go agreements do not have an end date.

next_token.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

Product.description:
An AWS Marketplace product owned by the calling seller. The fields
below are the most commonly consumed; additional listing-type-specific
fields may also be present.

cloud.description: Always `aws` for products returned by this API.

encrypted_productid.description:
The AWS Marketplace Catalog API encrypted product ID. Pass this
value as the `productId` path parameter on
`GET /products/{productId}/pricing`.

vendorid.description: Tackle vendor (ISV) ID that owns the product.

ProductPricing.description:
Pricing dimensions, billing term defaults, and payment model defaults
for an AWS Marketplace product. Use the response to pre-populate a
private-offer creation form. Field semantics match the `Pricing`
schema -- see that schema for full descriptions.

CreatePrivateOfferRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating a private offer. The wrapper
controls how the request is processed; the `private_offer` field
carries the offer payload.

For AWS, the `private_offer.offer_type` field discriminates the body
shape:

- `direct` -- ISV-to-buyer offer.
- `partner_resale` -- AWS resale (Resale Authorization + CPPO) offer.

See the `PrivateOffer` schema for the full set of fields supported by
the `private_offer` body. Conditional validation rules (e.g.
`service_start_at` is required when `billing_term` is `future_dated`)
are enforced server-side.

create_in_marketplace.description:
When `false`, creates a draft offer in Tackle only. When `true`,
additional marketplace-specific validation is applied and the
offer is sent to the marketplace after being saved in Tackle.

send_buyer_instructions.description:
Whether the buyer should receive purchase-instructions email
immediately after the offer is created. Must be `true` for AWS
offers that are pushed to marketplace.

dry_run.description:
When `true`, validates the payload without saving it or sending
it to the marketplace. A successful dry run returns `200`; a
successful real run returns `201`.

vendorid.description:
Vendor ID to use for the offer. Inferred from the bearer token
when omitted.

private_offer.description: The offer payload. See `PrivateOffer` for full field documentation.

dry_run.description: Echoes the `dry_run` flag from the request.

MarketplaceCreatePrivateOfferRequest.description:
Request body for promoting an existing Tackle draft offer into AWS
Marketplace. Only the wrapper options are accepted; the offer payload
is taken from the existing draft.

send_buyer_instructions.description: Whether to send the buyer purchase-instructions email immediately.

dry_run.description:
When `true`, validates that the offer can be pushed without
actually pushing it. A successful dry run returns `200`; a
successful push returns `201`.

Error.description:
Error response. Endpoints in the **Private Offers** and **Marketplace**
tags return the error in a `message` field. The **Partners** endpoint
returns the error in an `error` field. At least one of the two will
always be populated.

message.description: Error message (Private Offers and Marketplace endpoints).

BadRequest.description: Request was malformed or failed validation.

Forbidden.description: Caller is authenticated but not authorized for this resource.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

TackleJwt.description:
Tackle-issued JWT bearer token. Pass as
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. The token must include a vendor ID
claim and the principal must hold the per-endpoint RBAC permission
listed in each operation's description.

tags.name: Private Offers
tags.description: AWS private-offer lifecycle (create, read, update, cancel, push to marketplace).

tags.name: Marketplace
tags.description: AWS Marketplace context endpoints used to assemble offers and amendments.
